apps.name: bsvOS
apps.blurb: The system shell: wallet, approvals, policy, messaging, apps and work boards — the macOS replacement for the Quickshell panel. Ships with the daemon at https://127.0.0.1:2121/bsvos/ and owns the 127.0.0.1 slot, so it never collides with the bundled feature apps on localhost.

apps.name: Pocket Pets
apps.blurb: Gacha buddies on BSV: raise pets, mint 1Sat NFT ordinals, battle, trade on the market. Runs on OS custody via window.bsv (needs entangleit.com/manifest.json).

apps.name: Atomic Market
apps.blurb: BRC-100 atomic-swap market: browse listings, buy ordinals and BSV21 tokens (payment + asset in one tx), list your own. Installs with window.bsv under this origin's policy.

apps.name: Cast
apps.blurb: Value-for-value player: plays episode audio/video (files and HLS livestreams) and streams sats per minute across the episode's value splits while you listen. Shares the localhost identity with Twetch, Explorer and Colosseum — switching installs this one and replaces whichever is there.

apps.name: Twetch
apps.blurb: Feed and notifications companion: read the public Twetch feed, post text on-chain through the OS wallet (network fee only). Shares the localhost identity with Cast, Explorer and Colosseum — switching replaces whichever is installed.

apps.name: bsvOS Explorer
apps.blurb: Local block explorer: reads the public chain through WhatsOnChain and the local wallet's own history. Read-only; never signs or spends. Shares the localhost identity with Cast, Twetch and Colosseum — switching replaces whichever is installed.

apps.name: Ordinal Colosseum
apps.blurb: Ordinal Colosseum: reads your 1Sat ordinals through the local wallet, runs deterministic battles on this machine, and can inscribe an optional 1-sat champion medal. Shares the localhost identity with Cast, Twetch and Explorer — switching replaces whichever is installed.

apps.name: Meme Studio
apps.blurb: Search the Twetch Meme Library, caption templates, and post finished memes on-chain through the OS wallet. Shares the localhost identity with the other bundled apps — switching replaces whichever is installed.
